fire-warning.title: Early Fire Warning System
fire-warning.subtitle: Deep learning · Jetson · Aliyun IoT · Phone alert

cardImage.alt: Early fire warning robot car with camera

blocks.text: Deep learning · Jetson · Aliyun IoT · Phone alert
Deep-learning smoke and flame detection with cloud upload and automatic phone alerts.

image.alt: Mobile robot platform with camera and Jetson compute
image.caption: Phase 1 — mobile platform: car + camera + edge compute.

blocks.text: A deep-learning early fire warning system for factories, warehouses, and campuses: cameras watch for smoke and flame around the clock, then push alerts to the cloud and call emergency contacts.

YOLOv5 (lightened for embedded devices) runs on Jetson-class hardware. When fire is detected, an IoT module reports the camera ID and can dial a preset phone number while the mini program flags the abnormal channel in red.
From car + camera to pure camera
We started on a mobile robot—drive unit, stereo/LiDAR sensing, and onboard compute—so the team could validate detection while moving.
Later we simplified to a fixed Hikvision camera on a tripod with Jetson edge compute and a cellular/IoT board—easier to deploy at scale without the chassis.

images.alt: Fire-car robot with Mecanum wheels and sensors
images.caption: Start — vehicle + camera platform

images.alt: Hikvision camera with Jetson and IoT antenna board
images.caption: Later — pure camera + edge + modem

blocks.text: Flame and smoke samples were collected, cleaned, and labeled (thousands of frames) for YOLOv5 training, then lightened so the model fits embedded runtime with only a small accuracy trade-off.
Detection boxes mark fire and smoke in real scenes—parking lots, industrial chimneys, building exteriors—before the alert path fires.

blocks.text: On-device runs of the detection script print fire / no-fire lines in real time. Bench tests with a lighter confirmed the pipeline from camera frame to alert trigger.
